title: ADE: A Zero-Training Unlearning Method for Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.31998v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent world models learn compact recurrent dynamics from offline trajectories, yet deployed simulators can retain backdoor triggers or stale transitions from outdated physical regimes. Existing unlearning methods fail in autoregressive physics: gradient updates distort latent manifolds and compound rollout drift, naive output zeroing suppresses valid control responses on trigger onset, and single-step deletion leaves corruption inside recurrent hidden states. We propose Analytical Dynamics Excision (ADE), a deterministic, zero-training closed-form unlearning algorithm for latent world models. Using only cached pretraining moments, ADE recovers retain covariances via single-pass matrix downdating without raw retain data and cascades closed-form edits across the input bottleneck, hidden states, and downstream heads. Pairing orthogonal excision with whitened recurrent damping and mean-preserving affine calibration neutralizes out-of-mani

translated_title: ADE：一种面向潜在世界模型的零训练遗忘方法
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型从离线轨迹中学习紧凑的循环动力学，但已部署的模拟器可能保留后门触发器或来自过时物理机制的陈旧转移。现有的遗忘方法在自回归物理场景中失效：梯度更新会扭曲潜在流形并加剧滚动预测漂移，朴素的输出清零会在触发器出现时抑制有效的控制响应，而单步删除会在循环隐藏状态内部留下损坏。我们提出了分析动力学切除（ADE），这是一种面向潜在世界模型的确定性、零训练的闭式遗忘算法。ADE 仅利用缓存的预训练统计矩，通过单次矩阵降更新恢复保留数据的协方差，无需原始保留数据，并将闭式编辑级联作用于输入瓶颈、隐藏状态和下游头部。将正交切除与白化循环阻尼和均值保持仿射校准相结合，可中和流形外污染（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出零训练闭式遗忘算法ADE，仅利用缓存的预训练统计矩即可从潜在世界模型中精准切除后门触发器与过时物理机制的污染，且无需原始保留数据、不扭曲潜在流形、不损害有效控制响应。
en_tdlr: Proposes ADE, a deterministic zero-training closed-form unlearning algorithm that excises backdoor triggers and stale physical regimes from latent world models using only cached pretraining moments, without raw retain data, latent manifold distortion, or suppression of valid control responses.
